name: Compartir Cadaqués
neighborhood: Old town · Riera de Sant Vicenç
address: Riera de Sant Vicenç s/n, 17488 Cadaqués, Girona
tier: THE BERTHS · THE ELBULLI LINE AND THE SEA WALL
recognition: MICHELIN Guide selection, no star (listed on guide.michelin.com; Mapstr cites the 2026 selection) · 2 Soles Guía Repsol
what_to_order: Chef's sharing menu|Empordà seafood rice|Gazpacho with pesto|Tuna roll|Duck|Sea bass
price_range: Chef's menu about EUR 80 per person (Macarfi); Time Out range EUR 30-100 (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead by phone or through the website; the tasting menu is served to the whole table
notes: The whole-table tasting menu, anchored by an Empordà seafood rice.
verdict: elBulli-trained refinement on the harbour — book it for the rice, not for a casual lunch.
caveat: Seasonal and changeable: opening days vary through the year and no 2026 closing date was found, so phone before planning an autumn or winter dinner. Some 2026 diners found the menu expensive for what arrives. It is a sharing format, so the whole table eats the same menu.
hot_this_month: The MICHELIN Spain 2027 stars are announced on 24 November; the house closes in deep winter, so confirm its autumn dates before booking (checked 18 Oct 2026).

name: Talla
tier: THE ELBULLI LINE AND THE SEA WALL
what_to_order: Flame-grilled oysters with ponzu|Seaweed salad with goose barnacles and razor clams|Bloody Mary gazpacho|Steak tartare|Tuna tataki|Scallops with Ibérico ham and artichokes
price_range: EUR 25-50 per person (Time Out, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead, especially for the terrace; diners in 2026 report it is hard to get a table
caveat: Shuts for the winter (roughly November to March per Macarfi) and no 2026 closing date was found, so phone before an end-of-October visit. The terrace is small and fills fast in July and August; one 2025 reviewer found it as crowded as a city promenade.
hot_this_month: Last weeks before its winter break (closed roughly November to March): the terrace is easier to book than in summer; phone +34 972 258 739 first (checked 18 Oct 2026).

name: Es Baluard
neighborhood: Old-town sea wall · Riba Nemesi Llorens
tier: THE ELBULLI LINE AND THE SEA WALL
what_to_order: Monkfish suquet|Grilled fish of the day|Seafood rice|House-cured anchovies|Empordà wine by the bottle
reservation: Book by phone; the two window tables and the balcony table carry a waiting list
caveat: Season dates were not found for 2026; it traded in April and August, but phone before an autumn or winter visit. Ask for one of the window or balcony tables when you book: Ara reports a waiting list for them.

name: Casa Anita
tier: THE BERTHS · THE OLD HOUSES — DATED
what_to_order: House-salted Cadaqués anchovies|Grilled Roses prawns|Whole fish of the day|Sardines|House ice cream
price_range: About EUR 40 per person, about EUR 50 with wine and dessert (Mapstr diners); four anchovy toasts about EUR 17 per person (Tripadvisor, 2026) (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Reservations accepted by phone (listings, 2026); otherwise turn up and wait for a place at a shared table
notes: House-salted Cadaqués anchovies, grilled Roses prawns, then the ice cream churned on site.
verdict: The village institution Dalí drank at — you order what they recite, not what you planned.
caveat: No written menu: dishes and prices are recited, and several 2026 reviewers were surprised by the bill, so ask the fish price before you order. Tables are shared with strangers. Opening days differ between listings. Payment method not confirmed.

name: Can Rafa
what_to_order: Lobster rice (arròs de llamàntol)|Prawn rice|Fideuà|Salt cod carpaccio|Carmen Faixó's desserts|Martín Faixó wines
caveat: Rice and fideuà are made for at least two diners, so order them as a table. Reviewers in 2026 find prices on the high side. Phone not confirmed from a primary source; season dates for 2026 not found.

name: Casa Nun
what_to_order: Arròs caldós de llamàntol|Gratinated sardine|Black rice|Seafood paella|Turbot
reservation: Book through OpenTable (Restaurant CasaNun) or walk in
caveat: Small and family-run; opening days differ between listings, so call ahead. Some reviewers report slow or brusque service in high season. The street number differs between listings (6 or 9).

name: La Sirena
address: Carrer des Call s/n, 17488 Cadaqués, Girona
tier: ONE STREET BACK — THE CATCH WITHOUT THE VIEW
price_range: EUR 30-40 per person (Restaurant Guru, seen Oct 2026)
caveat: Easy to walk past on a side street with no sea view. Closing day differs between listings. Sea urchins are a January-to-March dish only. No 2026-dated review was found in this check.
hot_this_month: Before the urchins: the house's urchins are a January-March thing, so this month order the escórpora (scorpionfish) with sauce and potatoes; it takes reservations (checked 18 Oct 2026).

name: Es Balconet
neighborhood: Old town · Carrer de Sant Antoni
address: Carrer de Sant Antoni 2, 17488 Cadaqués, Girona
tier: ONE STREET BACK — THE CATCH WITHOUT THE VIEW
what_to_order: Paella|Black paella|Suquet de peix|Grilled catch of the day|Allioli
price_range: Set menu about EUR 22 reported by one guide (undated, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead in high season; small room
caveat: No sea view and a small room: book in summer. One April 2026 reviewer found the rice under-seasoned. Phone not confirmed.

name: S'Estrop
tier: THE BEACH, THE HILL AND THE CAPE
what_to_order: Fideuà|Paella|Black rice|Fresh fish from the charcoal oven|Fish soup
price_range: Set lunch EUR 22.50 (listing, undated, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book for terrace tables in summer
caveat: Reviews are mixed on the rice: some praise the fideuà, others found the paella disappointing. Season dates for 2026 not found.

name: Es Bar de Dalt
neighborhood: Upper village · road to Cap de Creus
address: Call ahead: listings give Carretera de Cap de Creus 2 and Carrer de Carles Rahola 2, Cadaqués
tier: THE BEACH, THE HILL AND THE CAPE
reservation: Arrive early in high season or phone ahead at midday
caveat: Fills quickly in high season. Parking on the road is tight; walk up. Address and hours differ between listings.

name: Restaurant Cap de Creus
address: Carretera Cap de Creus s/n (Far de Cap de Creus), 17488 Cadaqués, Girona
tier: THE BEACH, THE HILL AND THE CAPE
what_to_order: Vindaloo|Lamb karahi|Fish curry|Samosas with chutney|Seafood rice
reservation: Reserve through the website: Time Out says access by car is restricted to diners with a booking (others risk a fine), and a booking also gets a EUR 3.50 return shuttle fare
notes: One of the seven curries (the vindaloo) with samosas and chutney.
verdict: Seven curries above a Catalan cove at the edge of the mainland — the unlikely one that works.
caveat: The lighthouse road is a natural-park access zone: book through the website before driving up, or take the shuttle. Service is slow at busy times, by 2026 reviewers' accounts. Hours not confirmed for this autumn.
hot_this_month: The cape is outside the summer car controls in October, so the lighthouse terrace is reachable without the summer shuttle; hours are seasonal, so email reserves@restaurantcapdecreus.com before the drive (checked 18 Oct 2026).

name: Marítim Bar
tier: THE BERTHS · LE BAR — THE ROOMS WITH A STORY
what_to_order: Cremat|Breakfast on the beach|Patatas bravas|Tuna tataki
price_range: Croissants called expensive by a 2026 reviewer; no price list found (seen Oct 2026)
caveat: Come for the position and the history: Tripadvisor scores it low (2.8/5) with recurring service complaints. Seasonal hours are not published; the mobile phone may go unanswered out of season.

name: L'Hostal
tier: LE BAR — THE ROOMS WITH A STORY
reservation: Book through TheFork or by phone if eating; walk in for a drink
caveat: The nightclub of the Dalí years is gone; this is now a restaurant and bar living on its history. The logo date and founding story come from blogs and listings, not an archive.
hot_this_month: A quiet autumn aperitif in the bar whose logo Dalí designed; walk in for a drink, book if eating (checked 18 Oct 2026).
